'''''Alphabet Squadron''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Alexander Freed]]. The book is the first in the ''[[Star Wars: Alphabet Squadron]]'' series, and it was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[June 11]], [[2019]]. Set after [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], ''Alphabet Squadron'' focuses on a [[Alphabet Squadron|group]] of [[New Republic pilot]]s hunting down an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] group called [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing|Shadow Wing]], and it crosses over with the [[Marvel Comics]] miniseries [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (comic series)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. A sequel to the novel, ''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]'', was published in [[2020]].
